mapper.sql: select r.*, u.nickname, u.level_image from reply r left join user u on r.user_idx = u.idx
mapper.select: select count(*) from reply where board_idx = #{boardIdx}

select r.*, u.nickname, u.level_image, b.title, b.type, b.reply_count as board_reply_count from reply r join user u on r.user_idx = u.idx join board b on b.idx = r.board_idx where r.user_idx = #{userIdx} order by r.written_date desc, r.idx desc
mapper.insert: insert into reply (board_idx, user_idx, content, parent_reply_idx, reply_depth) values (#{boardIdx}, #{userIdx}, #{content}, #{parentReplyIdx}, #{replyDepth})
mapper.update: update reply set parent_reply_idx = idx where idx = #{idx}
update reply set content = #{content}, modify_date = now() where idx = #{idx}
